method.basis: Direct published England and ICB rows from Tables 1 to 4.
method.snapshot: Point-in-time bed provision and usage close to midnight on 4 March 2026; not an annual total.
method.length_of_stay: Published average length of stay, not calculated from the bed count.

notes: The audit covers NHS, jointly commissioned and Better Care Fund beds used for intermediate care purposes.
Bed capacity can change; the figures describe the published snapshot date only.
Block-contract and spot-purchase counts do not necessarily sum to all beds because some beds were not assigned to either category.
This ICB-based publication does not provide a community-provider selector.
